sentences.en: I've been intrigued by this question of whether we could evolve or develop a sixth sense -- a sense that would give us seamless access and easy access to meta-information or information that may exist somewhere
sentences.zh: 我对这个关于我们能否进化或发展第六感的问题很感兴趣, 这种感官能让我们无缝地 获取和方便地获取 某些地方可能存在的元信息或信息。

sentences.en: that may be relevant to help us make the right decision about whatever it is that we're coming across.
sentences.zh: 这也许能帮助我们做出正确的决定 不论我们遇到什么事情

sentences.en: And some of you may argue, "Well, don't today's cell phones do that already?"
sentences.zh: 你们中有些人可能会争论, “今天的手机是不是已经这样了?”

sentences.en: But I would say no. When you meet someone here at TED -- and this is the top networking place, of course, of the year -- you don't shake somebody's hand and then say, "Can you hold on for a moment while I take out my phone and Google you?"
sentences.zh: 但我会说不。当你在TED遇到一个人—— 当然,这是一年中最顶尖的网络场所—— 你不和别人握手,然后说,“我拿出手机和谷歌时你能不能等一下?”

sentences.en: Or when you go to the supermarket and you're standing there in that huge aisle of different types of toilet papers, you don't take out your cell phone, and open a browser, and go to a website to try to decide which of these different toilet papers
sentences.zh: 或者当你去超市的时候,你站在 各种卫生纸的巨大过道里, 你不拿出你的手机, 打开一个浏览器, 并去一个网站 试图决定这些不同的卫生纸中的哪一个

sentences.en: is the most ecologically responsible purchase to make.
sentences.zh: 这是最生态上负责的购买。

sentences.en: So we don't really have easy access to all this relevant information that can just help us make optimal decisions about what to do next and what actions to take.
sentences.zh: 所以,我们并不容易获得所有这些相关信息, 这些信息可以帮助我们做出最佳决定, 来决定下一步要做什么和要做什么。

sentences.en: And so my research group at the Media Lab has been developing a series of inventions to give us access to this information in a sort of easy way,
sentences.zh: 所以我在媒体实验室的研究小组 开发了一系列的发明 使我们能轻松地获取这些信息

sentences.en: without requiring that the user changes any of their behavior.
sentences.zh: 并不要求用户改变他们的行为。

sentences.en: And I'm here to unveil our latest effort, and most successful effort so far, which is still very much a work in process.
sentences.zh: 我在这里展示我们的最新努力, 以及迄今为止最成功的努力, 仍然非常是一个工作的过程。

sentences.en: I'm actually wearing the device right now and we've sort of cobbled it together with components that are off the shelf -- and that, by the way, only cost 350 dollars at this point in time.
sentences.zh: 实际上,我正在穿戴这个装置, 我们把它和 架子外的部件放在一起, 顺便说一下,目前只花了350美元。

sentences.en: I'm wearing a camera, just a simple web cam, a portable, battery-powered projection system with a little mirror.
sentences.zh: 我穿着一个相机, 只是一个简单的网络摄像头, 一个便携的,电池驱动的投影系统 与一个小镜子。

sentences.en: These components communicate to my cell phone in my pocket which acts as the communication and computation device.
sentences.zh: 这些部件与我口袋里的手机通信 手机是通讯和计算装置

sentences.en: And in the video here we see my student Pranav Mistry, who's really the genius who's been implementing and designing this whole system.
sentences.zh: 在这段视频里,我们看到了我的学生Pranav Mistry, 谁是真正的天才 谁一直在实施和设计 整个系统。

sentences.en: And we see how this system lets him walk up to any surface and start using his hands to interact with the information that is projected in front of him.
sentences.zh: 我们看到这个系统如何让他走到任何表面 并开始使用他的双手 与他面前的信息互动。

sentences.en: The system tracks the four significant fingers.
sentences.zh: 系统跟踪四个重要的手指。

sentences.en: In this case, he's wearing simple marker caps that you may recognize.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下,他穿着简单的标记帽 你可能会认出来。

sentences.en: But if you want a more stylish version, you could also paint your nails in different colors.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想要更时髦的版本, 你也可以用不同的颜色来涂指甲。

sentences.en: And the camera basically tracks these four fingers and recognizes any gestures that he's making so he can just go to, for example, a map of Long Beach, zoom in and out, etc.
sentences.zh: 摄像头基本上跟踪了这四个手指 并识别了他所做的任何手势 这样他就可以去,例如, 一张长滩地图, 放大,等等。

sentences.en: The system also recognizes iconic gestures such as the "take a picture" gesture, and then takes a picture of whatever is in front of you.
sentences.zh: 系统也承认像“拍照”的标志性手势, 然后拍摄你面前的任何东西。

sentences.en: And when he then walks back to the Media Lab, he can just go up to any wall and project all the pictures that he's taken, sort through them and organize them, and re-size them, etc., again using all natural gestures.
sentences.zh: 当他回到媒体实验室时, 他可以走到任何墙上, 放映他拍的所有照片, 整理和整理这些照片, 并用所有的自然手势来调整它们大小,等等。

sentences.en: So, some of you most likely were here two years ago and saw the demo by Jeff Han, or some of you may think, "Well, doesn't this look like the Microsoft Surface Table?"
sentences.zh: 所以,你们中有些人 最有可能是两年前在这里 看到了杰夫汉的演示, 或者你们中有些人可能会想,"嗯,这看起来像不 微软表面表?"

sentences.en: And yes, you also interact using natural gestures, both hands, etc.
sentences.zh: 是的,你还用自然的手势, 双手,等等来互动。

sentences.en: But the difference here is that you can use any surface, you can walk up to any surface, including your hand, if nothing else is available, and interact with this projected data.
sentences.zh: 但是这里的区别是 你可以使用任何表面, 你可以走到任何表面, 包括你的手, 如果没有其他可用的话, 并与这个预测的数据互动。

sentences.en: The device is completely portable, and can be -- (Applause) (Applause ends) So, one important difference is that it's totally mobile.
sentences.zh: 设备是完全可移动的,并且可以 -- (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声结束) 所以,一个重要的区别是它完全移动。

sentences.en: Another even more important difference is that in mass production, this would not cost more tomorrow than today's cell phones and would actually not sort of be a bigger packaging --
sentences.zh: 另一个更重要的区别是,在大规模生产中, 明天的成本不会超过今天的手机, 实际上也不会是一个更大的包装。

sentences.en: could look a lot more stylish than this version that I'm wearing around my neck.
sentences.zh: 可能看起来比这个版本更时髦 我戴在我的脖子上。

sentences.en: But other than letting some of you live out your fantasy of looking as cool as Tom Cruise in "Minority Report," the reason why we're really excited about this device
sentences.zh: 但除了让你们中的一些人 过着像汤姆·克鲁斯那样酷的幻想之外 这也是为什么我们对于这个装置很兴奋的原因

sentences.en: is that it really can act as one of these sixth-sense devices that gives you relevant information about whatever is in front of you.
sentences.zh: 它可以真正发挥一种第六感的装置 让你了解你眼前的一切

sentences.en: So we see Pranav here going into the supermarket and he's shopping for some paper towels.
sentences.zh: 所以,我们看到Pranav在这里 进入超市 他购物 一些纸巾。

sentences.en: And, as he picks up a product, the system can recognize the product that he's picking up, using either image recognition or marker technology, and give him the green light or an orange light.
sentences.zh: 当他采集产品时 系统可以识别他采集的产品 使用图像识别或标记技术 给他绿灯或橙色灯光

sentences.en: He can ask for additional information. So this particular choice here is a particularly good choice, given his personal criteria.
sentences.zh: 他可以要求更多信息。因此,鉴于他的个人标准,这一特殊选择是一个特别好的选择。

sentences.en: Some of you may want the toilet paper with the most bleach in it rather than the most ecologically responsible choice.
sentences.zh: 你们中有些人可能想要 最有漂白剂的卫生纸 而不是最对生态负责的选择

sentences.en: (Laughter) If he picks up a book in the bookstore, he can get an Amazon rating -- it gets projected right on the cover of the book.
sentences.zh: 如果他在书店里捡到一本书, 他可以得到亚马逊的评分-- 书的封面就被预测了。

sentences.en: This is Juan's book, our previous speaker, which gets a great rating, by the way, at Amazon.
sentences.zh: 这是胡安的书,我们的前一位演讲者, 顺便说一句,在亚马逊得到很高的评价。

sentences.en: And so, Pranav turns the page of the book and can then see additional information about the book -- reader comments, maybe sort of information by his favorite critic, etc.
sentences.zh: 因此,Pranav翻过这本书的页面, 可以看到更多关于这本书的信息-- 读者的评论, 也许是他最喜欢的评论家提供的信息,等等。

sentences.en: If he turns to a particular page, he finds an annotation by maybe an expert or a friend of ours that gives him a little bit of additional information about whatever is on that particular page.
sentences.zh: 如果他转向某一页,他就会发现我们的一个专家或朋友的注解,给他一些关于该页内容的补充信息。

sentences.en: Reading the newspaper -- it never has to be outdated.
sentences.zh: 阅读报纸 -- -- 绝不能过时。

sentences.en: (Laughter) You can get video annotations of the events that you're reading about.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 你可以得到视频 描述你正在读到的事件。

sentences.en: You can get the latest sports scores, etc.
sentences.zh: 你可以拿到最新的体育成绩,等等。

sentences.en: This is a more controversial one. (Laughter) As you interact with someone at TED, maybe you can see a word cloud of the tags, the words that are associated with that person
sentences.zh: 这是一个更具争议性的一个。 (笑声) 当你在TED与某人互动时, 也许你可以看到一个字的云 标记, 和那个人有关的单词

sentences.en: in their blog and personal web pages. In this case, the student is interested in cameras, etc.
sentences.zh: 学生对摄像头感兴趣。

sentences.en: On your way to the airport, if you pick up your boarding pass, it can tell you that your flight is delayed, that the gate has changed, etc.
sentences.zh: 在去机场的路上,如果你拿起你的登机证, 它可以告诉你,你的航班推迟了, 门变了,等等。

sentences.en: And, if you need to know what the current time is, it's as simple as drawing a watch -- (Laughter) (Applause) on your arm.
sentences.zh: 而且,如果你需要知道现在是什么时间, 它就像在你的手臂上画手表一样简单。

sentences.en: So that's where we're at so far in developing this sixth sense that would give us seamless access to all this relevant information about the things that we may come across.
sentences.zh: 因此,这就是我们目前发展第六感, 使我们能够无缝地 获得关于我们可能遇到的事物的所有相关信息。

sentences.en: My student Pranav, who's really, like I said, the genius behind this.
sentences.zh: 我的学生Pranav, 谁真的,就像我说的, 天才背后的这一点。

sentences.en: (Applause and cheering) (Applause ends)
sentences.zh: (掌声和欢呼声) (掌声结束)

sentences.en: He does deserve a lot of applause, because I don't think he's slept much in the last three months, actually.
sentences.zh: 他确实应该得到很多的掌声, 因为我不认为他 睡了很多在过去三个月,其实。

sentences.en: And his girlfriend is probably not very happy about him either.
sentences.zh: 他的女朋友可能也不太喜欢他

sentences.en: But it's not perfect yet, it's very much a work in progress.
sentences.zh: 但它还不是完美的, 它是一个非常 工作正在进行。

sentences.en: And who knows, maybe in another 10 years we'll be here with the ultimate sixth sense brain implant.
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢 也许再过10年 我们就会在这里 接受第六感大脑植入手术

sentences.en: Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢。 （掌声）
